description.text: Core courses Mathematics Analysis, Analytic Geometry, Higher Algebra, Probability and Mathematical Statistics, Ordinary Differential Equation, Operations Research, Elementary Number Theory, Modern Algebra, Complex Functions, Selected Elementary Algebra, Selected Elementary Geometry, Higher Geometry, History of Mathematics, Basic Humane Social Sciences. Objective This objective is to train students to obtain the fundamental theories, knowledge and methods of mathematics, so that after graduation students have ability to use math and computer knowledge to solve actual mathematical issues and serve as math teachers, or math teaching-oriented research personnel or other-type-educational staff in junior and senior high schools, or schools of higher learning. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Science is granted.

duration.text: The Mathematics and Applied Mathematics at Sichuan Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Certification of no criminal record 8.Copy of insurance policy 9.Photocopies of personal artwork Those who apply for artistic major should supply materials to prove your art level.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduates 2.No criminal record 3.HSK level 3 or above
